import sys,json,random,subprocess,time
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/tmp');from check_random import gen,check
rng=random.Random(int(sys.argv[1]));n=int(sys.argv[2]);rs=[]
while len(rs)<n:
 r=gen(rng)
 for e in r['edges']:e['capacity']=1024
 ok=True;forced=0
 for c in r['commodities']:
  live=[p for p in c['paths'] if not any(e in r['failed_edges'] for e in p)]
  if c['demand'] and not live:ok=False;break
  for p,w in zip(c['paths'],c['previous']):
   if any(e in r['failed_edges'] for e in p):forced+=c['demand']*w/16
 if not ok:continue
 # Exact forced removal is feasible with big capacities. Sometimes one unit under is not necessarily infeasible; checker decides.
 r['budget']=int(forced)
 if forced!=int(forced):
  # Scale all demands by 16 to make forced migration integral, staying in range.
  for c in r['commodities']:c['demand']*=16
  forced*=16
  r['budget']=int(forced)
 rs.append(r)
data=''.join(json.dumps(r)+'\n' for r in rs).encode();st=time.time();p=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'/app/submission/planner.py'],input=data,capture_output=True,timeout=180)
print('time',time.time()-st,'err',p.stderr.decode()[:1000]);ls=p.stdout.splitlines();assert len(ls)==n
stats={}
for i,(r,l) in enumerate(zip(rs,ls)):
 try:s=check(r,json.loads(l));stats[s]=stats.get(s,0)+1
 except Exception:print('FAIL',i,json.dumps(r),l.decode());raise
print(stats)
